meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把一个 DAG 定义保存成库里的 <name>.json 文件,之后按名字加载并启动,不必每次粘贴定义。节点里的 {{key}}、{{date}} 等占位符在加载时填充。
howto.when: 当你提到保存 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或要重复调度同一个多智能体图时触发。

say.text: 把当前的 DAG 保存为 nightly-audit

say.note: key 轮转为带 UTC 时间戳的新运行
key 固定为该后缀,可幂等复用

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can save a DAG definition as a <name>.json file, then load and start it by name instead of pasting it each time. Placeholders like {{key}} and {{date}} fill in at load time.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit

say_en.note: Key rotates to a fresh UTC-timestamped run
Key is fixed to that suffix for idempotent reuse
